=FIDOJ EMOCN Y=
The light at the top of the Carrier's control tower blinks in morse code, spelling the message in the title. <ref>http://forums.bistudio.com/showthread.php?141799-control-tower-blinking-light-is-morse-code</ref> The message in Czech is FIDO JE MOCNY, which in English means '''Fido is mighty'''. Fido being a nickname of the engine's lead programmer Filip Doksanský. <ref>http://forums.bistudio.com/showthread.php?141799-control-tower-blinking-light-is-morse-code&p=2249131&viewfull=1#post2249131</ref>
